question: What is the total number of single bonds in cyclopentane?
solution:
The correct answer is __**15**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Cyclopentane (C₅H₁₀) is a saturated cyclic hydrocarbon with five carbon atoms.
 
• Each carbon atom forms 2 single bonds with adjacent carbon atoms and 2 single bonds with hydrogen atoms.
 
• There are a total of 5 carbon-carbon single bonds in cyclopentane.
 
• Each of the 5 carbon atoms forms 2 single bonds with hydrogen atoms, resulting in a total of 10 carbon-hydrogen single bonds.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Cyclopentane**

 
 
• Cyclopentane is a cyclic hydrocarbon with the molecular formula C₅H₁₀.
 
• It is a non-aromatic compound, meaning it does not have the delocalized π-electron cloud characteristic of aromatic compounds like benzene.
 
• In cyclopentane, each carbon atom is sp³ hybridized, forming four sigma (σ) bonds.
 
• The structure of cyclopentane is a five-membered ring, which can adopt conformations like envelope and half-chair to relieve angle strain.
 
 
 
• **Single Bonds**
 
 
• Single bonds are covalent bonds where two atoms share one pair of electrons.
 
• They are represented by a single line between the two atoms in chemical structures.
 
• Single bonds are sigma (σ) bonds, which are formed by the head-on overlap of atomic orbitals.
 
• In the context of hydrocarbons, single bonds can occur between carbon atoms (C-C) or between carbon and hydrogen atoms (C-H).
 
 
 
• **Saturated Hydrocarbons**
 
 
• Saturated hydrocarbons are compounds that contain only single bonds between carbon atoms.
 
• They are also known as alkanes and cycloalkanes.
 
• In saturated hydrocarbons, each carbon atom is bonded to the maximum number of hydrogen atoms possible.
 
• Examples include methane (CH₄), ethane (C₂H₆), and cyclohexane (C₆H₁₂).
